findings.title: Mandatory formula re-pin, chmod, and lint operator hand-offs are optional or absent
T002 and T013 assign command execution to the non-executing implementer
T007 can land before T010 makes its lint failures actionable
T007 does not require a failing candidate gate to prevent ref advancement
Every task redundantly runs tests/run.sh after ci-local already runs the full suite
T003 lacks focused coverage for the obsolete soft-surface prompt path
T005 lacks a deterministic focused test for prompt echo and plausible hallucination
T006 lacks explicit dirty-checkout and durable-state preservation cases
T009 does not explicitly test doctor's no-inbound-probe result
Cross-cutting documentation and final run-level acceptance have no owning task
